### Quick eval — one-click accuracy
Runs a built-in labeled set through the **Triage Agent** and returns a scorecard (verdict + severity accuracy) right in the output. **Self-contained** — cases are embedded here, so no Data Table / project dependency.

**Two ways to run:**
- Click **Test workflow** (manual trigger) — report shows on the canvas.
- GET the webhook `secops-eval-run` — JSON scorecard in the response.

The table-backed version (Evaluations tab metrics) is the separate *SecOps — Eval: Triage accuracy* workflow.
